businessDetails.name: Norwen Beauty Salon
businessDetails.subheadline: Experience bespoke hair design, luminous balayage, and couture nail artistry in an intimate, relaxing boutique sanctuary in Terrace End, Palmerston North.
businessDetails.address: 98 Napier Road, Terrace End, Palmerston North 4410, New Zealand
businessDetails.addressShort: 98 Napier Road, Terrace End, Palmerston North

services.title: Haircut and Styling
services.description: Professional precision haircut tailored to your natural hair texture and face shape, finished with a fresh, bouncy blow-dry style.

services.title: Color and Highlights
services.description: Luminous dimensional foils, seamless balayage, or vibrant full color coverage tailored to brighten your complexion and add healthy radiance.

services.title: Perm and Straightening
services.description: Transform your natural hair: gorgeous bouncy, defined curls with a gentle perm, or ultra-silky, smooth chemical straightening for easy daily styling.

services.title: Hair Spa
services.description: A deeply restorative spa ritual combining rich botanical moisture with an invigorating scalp massage to revive dull, stressed, or dry tresses.

services.title: Keratin Treatment
services.description: Intensive protein smoothing therapy that seals damaged cuticles, eliminates stubborn humidity frizz, and imparts radiant glass-like shine.

services.title: Deep Conditioning
services.description: Instant targeted hydration and lipid replenishment to restore softness, combability, and healthy bounce to dry or heat-styled hair.

services.title: Threading
services.description: Gentle, ultra-precise facial hair threading for crisp, clean eyebrow shaping, upper lip, and facial grooming without chemicals or harsh peeling.

services.title: Waxing
services.description: Hygienic, comfortable body waxing using premium skin-calming wax formulas for silky, touchable smoothness that lasts for weeks.

services.title: Manicure & Pedicure
services.description: Pampering nail shaping, meticulous cuticle care, soothing foot spa massage, and long-lasting glossy polish for beautifully rejuvenated hands and feet.
